newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - Ridley in A$12 mln feedmill expansion.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - Ridley in A$12 mln feedmill expansion.

text.p: Stockfeed group Ridley Corp Ltd said on Friday it was embarking on an expansion in Victoria's Western Districts worth a total cost of A$12 million.
Ridley said the first stage of the expansion was the purchase of Moloney's Produce, a feedmill business at Noorat, that sells about 60,000 tonnes of feed per annum to the region's dairy industry.

Ridley said the second stage of the expansion programme would be the construction of a feedmill in Terang with plans for Noorat mill production to be shifted to the new mill when it is operational in mid-1997.
The mill will produce pelletised stock feed for the region's burgeoning dairy industry as well as for cattle, pigs and poultry.
Ridley shares closed two cents lower at A$1.68 on turnover of 52,093 shares.
